# Floom

> Floom is a native Rust GUI library: self-drawn, retained-mode, GPU-accelerated, no browser dependency, with fine-grained reactivity. "Floom 2.0" workspace: edition 2024, MSRV 1.91, workspace version 0.2.0 (pre-1.0), MIT. The 1.0 bar is budgets + conformance suites, not competitor feature counts.

## Read in this order

- [Docs index](docs/README.md) — the map, the status dashboard, the doc rules
- [Vision](docs/vision.md) — goal, what we borrow from which competitor, moat, non-goals
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) — layers, three ABIs, contributor guide
- [Performance](docs/performance.md) — metric ledger (size, CPU, memory, GPU, frame time), current numbers, gates
- [Developer experience](docs/developer-experience.md) — `floom` CLI lifecycle, `run --watch`, devtools
- [AI first](docs/ai-first.md)
- [MCP server](crates/app/floom-mcp/README.md) — five tools in front of a running app; it attaches, it does not launch — the agent protocol that already exists, and what is missing
- [Platforms](docs/platforms.md) — 9 targets and per-platform capability bindings in one table
- [Tokens](docs/tokens.md) — the four layers a colour or a size may come from, and which changes are safe
- [Components](docs/components.md) — widget inventory, design-system conformance, component contract
- [Plugins](docs/plugins.md) — provider vtable contract, 22-plugin matrix
- [Roadmap](docs/roadmap.md) — the 13 gates to 1.0, current gaps, ordering, risks
- [Release policy](docs/release-policy.md) — versioning, supported-target authority, release steps
- [Renderers](docs/renderer-backend-support.md) — per-backend coverage, including what is deliberately counted-not-drawn
- [Examples](docs/examples.md) — golden examples (read by `docs_parity.rs` and `scripts/run-golden-examples.sh`)
- [Per-target gates](docs/gates/) — 8 items per platform, `pass`/`fail`/`n/a` with line-level evidence
- [Workspace conventions](docs/workspace-conventions.md)

## Quick facts for an agent

- Layout: `crates/{core,system,widgets,platform,render,native,devtools,frontend,app}`; the public facade is `crates/app/floom`. Design systems and the editor are separate workspaces under `crates/ecosystem/` and are **not** in the 1.0 surface.
- Tests that must keep compiling: `crates/app/floom/tests/{prelude_surface,feature_graph,docs_parity}.rs`. `docs_parity.rs` cross-checks `docs/examples.md` ↔ `examples/`, `docs/architecture.md` ↔ `scripts/check-architecture-deps.sh`, and every path named in `docs/release-policy.md`.
- Gates: run `just gate` (local). The `justfile` recipes are the real gate; `.github/workflows/` cannot run from this origin, so no CI badge means anything yet.
- Platform reality: only `aarch64-apple-darwin` is "tested". The other 8 targets are device- or target-gated — see the targets table in `docs/release-policy.md`.
- Agent protocol (already implemented, `crates/system/floom-accuracy/src/agent/`): commands `Tree`, `Semantics`, `Scene`, `Screenshot`, `Performance`, `Schema`, actions `Tap`, `TypeText`, `Drag`; selectors are `Label`/`Role` only (never a `NodeId`); transports are in-process and `127.0.0.1`-only with a dev token.
- Component schema: `component_schema()` yields slots, properties (`style`/`layout`/`widget` + closed domains), events, tokens, and a runnable example per widget kind.
- Benchmarks: `scripts/check-perf-budgets.sh` (10% budgets, single-machine baseline — deliberately not a CI gate) and `just gate size` (3 tiers).
- TypeScript: there is **no** published `npm/@types/floom`; `floom-tsx` generates Rust from TSX in-tree.
